diagnostic_before_picker_changes.scope: Exact Windows candidate. A loose menu subclass copied from hash-verified frozen source adds timestamps; the stock Battle class mounts normally and runs real activity. All timings are serial separate-process offline samples. Waits before collection represent time after the first check, including scheduler overlap, not decoder time per asset.

method: Each route ran in fresh offline processes in order baseline-candidate, then candidate-baseline, with a 400 ms window including picker opening. The immediate case launches from the same frame as picker creation. The normal Battle implementation and resources remain native. Whole-frame timings include machine scheduling and are descriptive.

source_surface_cache_bound.scope: Nominal sum of source pixel dimensions; not a process memory measurement. The warmed shared textures can remain referenced until the Windows game process exits.
